5090061366868.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive red and green wooden design adds a traditional Christmas charm to any home display.
Versatile hanging ornament suitable for creating focal points in coordinated seasonal arrangements.
Crafted from durable wood material, ensuring longevity and easy care for repeated annual use.
Single item pack allows flexible placement on shelves, mantels, or as part of a larger decorative grouping.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 1 hanging Christmas decoration
Hanger included

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Add navy blue colour and contrasting texture to your Christmas decorations with this pack of 6 matching 10cm thread ball baubles. Each round ornament has a thread-wrapped surface with a gold sequin band around the middle, bringing together fine lines and reflective detail in one design. A hanging loop above the decorative cap provides a way to position the bauble on a suitable tree branch or include it in a wreath or garland arrangement. The 10cm size creates a visible accent among foliage, ribbons and other hanging ornaments, while the navy blue finish helps you coordinate a consistent seasonal colour scheme. Use the matching pieces to repeat the design across the tree, or combine with your own plain and patterned decorations for a varied display. These Christmas tree ornaments also work in indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery, winter wedding decorations and festive party displays. This option contains 6 baubles, with the same thread covering and sequin-band design on each piece. Display the band facing forward so its sequin detail remains visible between branches.
Thread Ball Baubles: Includes 6 matching 10cm navy blue Christmas tree baubles, with a thread-wrapped surface and a gold sequin band around the middle. The round ornaments add colour and texture to Christmas tree decorations, wreaths and garlands, with the same finish on each selected piece.
Sequin Band Detail: The gold band contrasts with the navy blue thread covering, combining a textured finish with reflective sequin detail. Place these decorative Christmas balls among foliage and ribbons to add a different surface beside plain baubles in your seasonal arrangement.
Hanging Tree Ornaments: A loop above the decorative cap provides a hanging point for each bauble. Position the 10cm ornaments on suitable branches or incorporate them into a wreath or garland, spacing them between other decorations so the thread texture and sequin band remain visible.
Coordinated Christmas Decor: Use the navy blue colour to build a consistent tree theme, or combine the baubles with contrasting ornaments and ribbon. The round shape suits traditional Christmas decorations, winter wedding displays and festive party arrangements around the home.
Display And Pack Contents: Includes 6 matching decorative balls for a repeated accent, each measuring 10cm. Add to indoor window arrangements, mantel greenery or a decorated tree, then coordinate with your own bows, foliage and seasonal accessories for a display throughout the festive season.

5096042276768.baseName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Wreath making kit - Country-style patchwork and satin ribbon for a Christmas craft afternoon
5096042276768.variantName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Wreath making kit - Country-style patchwork and satin ribbon for a Christmas craft afternoon
5096042276768.sourceDescription:
Pre-cut fabric and satin ribbon give this wreath a mix of soft texture and a smoother finish. The country-style arrangement suits a kitchen or hall, where the fabric colours and ribbon can be seen at close range.

Patchwork brings together the softness of the cloth and the definition of a picture. Each section contributes to a larger shape, so progress is visible as you go and the finished decoration retains the small variations of handwork. The smoother ribbon picks up highlights beside the softer cloth. Let it lie naturally over the finished work and check the arrangement from the side so that the ribbon does not hide the fabric folds.

The layered surface gives the decoration a softer profile than a flat card or print. Position it where people can see the fabric at an angle as well as from the front, particularly if you display it beside a window. The prepared shapes make it easier to compare adjoining pieces before fixing them. Lay out a small group at a time, keeping the rest together so that similarly coloured pieces remain easy to identify.

Begin with the broad shapes and keep the smaller details together until you reach their place in the design. Seeing the outline develop first makes it easier to judge how the finished piece will look on a wall.

A wall beside a reading chair or a spot in the hall gives people a chance to see the handwork close up. Leave some space around the edge so that the pattern is easy to follow from the first detail to the last. The project lends itself to several short sessions in the run-up to Christmas. Keep the unfinished work flat with the remaining pieces grouped beside it so that it is easy to see where to begin next time.

For a shared craft afternoon, one person can sort the next colours while another works on the current section.
Pre-cut fabric and satin ribbon components simplify the crafting process for a quick Christmas project.
Country-style patchwork design combines soft textile textures with smooth ribbon highlights for a layered finish.
Ideal for shared craft afternoons, allowing multiple participants to sort colours and assemble sections together.
Creates a distinctive handcrafted decoration suitable for display in kitchens or halls near windows.
Comes with Pre-cut fabric pieces, satin ribbon

Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

5096042277468.sourceDescription:
Warm white LEDs are already set among the artificial needles, cones and red berries. Built-in hanging hooks let you put the 45 cm wreath on display with minimal preparation, whether you are dressing an entrance or an inside wall. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Small red berries show especially clearly against a simple backdrop. If you want to tie the wreath into a larger Christmas scheme, repeat their red in a nearby ornament and let the foliage provide the quieter colour.

From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail. Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree.

When packing away a lit decoration, support the body of the wreath and give the lighting components their own space. Store the controls alongside it so that they are easy to locate when the decorations come out again.

The black glass design features an etched stag scene that becomes more visible when the warm white copper wire micro LED lights are switched on. 5051641417868.baseName: Norway Spruce Real Fresh Cut Christmas Tree 4ft (120cm) - Delivery 7th - 11th December
5051641417868.variantName: Norway Spruce Real Fresh Cut Christmas Tree 4ft (120cm) - Delivery 7th - 11th December · 本规格 / Selected: 4ft
5051641417868.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
Christmas tree shape- Full
